itemName: Konaseema Chicken Fry Biryani Family Pack
description: Indulge in our Konaseema Chicken Fry Biryani Family Pack, featuring succulent, marinated chicken fried to perfection and layered with fragrant basmati rice. Infused with aromatic spices, caramelized onions, and fresh herbs, this hearty dish offers a delightful explosion of flavors that will bring your family together for a feast.
